reads.note: Same junction as t10_37R, at the top-left corner of plate 22-38's mapped area. Lafayette runs ENE (60'), Ludlow runs SSE along the W side; the NW leg of Ludlow and the 50' street stub to the N (hydrant at ~(67,557)) are cut off by the mapped-area boundary close to the crossing, but the crossing itself is inside the plate.

Lafayette (60-ft strip with 20in W.P. and 12in sewer) comes in from the NE and ends on Ludlow, which bends here: one leg runs S/SSE (street railway, 8in W.P.), the other runs W/NW off the left edge of the drawn area at x=0. Centre taken where Lafayette's centreline (between north edge ~(100,557)-(400,440) and lot-40 block edge ~(145,622)-(400,540)) meets Ludlow's centreline (west edge ~(40,665)-(75,750), east edge ~(140,620)-(185,750)); pipe lines cross at ~(55,607). Junction itself is visible, but the NW leg of Ludlow is cut by the plate/map edge only ~40-75 px west of the centre. Hydrant at ~(65,560), valve dot ~(60,640).
